text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Everything inside me... blazed, and 
blazed, and burned so bright...!! I 
reached Oguri-senpai! I won!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just when I was thinking what an awesome 
showdown that was, Oguri-senpai told me, 
"That was an amazing race!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And her current "dream" is to defeat me in 
the next race!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes... My "dream" definitely came true. 
But it's not over yet. My "dream" goes on 
and on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Our "dream" starts right here!! We'll 
blaze even brighter and create the 
greatest legendary showdowns time and time 
again!!
